parsed.observations: Leaf blades show prominent elongated brick-red pustules, some merging into raised patches with ragged margins, alongside smaller scattered reddish-brown pustules. Some leaves are yellowing; no white powdery growth or black-dotted necrotic blotches are visible.
parsed.summary: Visible symptoms strongly support stem rust, with large elongated brick-red pustules and ragged ruptured margins on leaf blades.
